# cmake/CMakeLists.txt -- AUTO-GENERATED by `tur fetch`. Do not edit.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(SpiceDeps)

include(FetchContent)

option(TUR_FETCH_FORCE_FETCH "Bypass system find_package for :prefer-system deps" OFF)

# hiredis
FetchContent_Declare(hiredis
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/redis/hiredis
  GIT_TAG        v1.2.0
)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(DISABLE_TESTS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(hiredis)
set(_hiredis_resolved_via "fetch" CACHE INTERNAL "")

# --- Generate spice-deps-manifest.json ---
set(_spice_manifest_path "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/spice-deps-manifest.json")
set(_spice_manifest "{\n")
set(_spice_first TRUE)

# manifest entry: hiredis
if(NOT _spice_first)
  string(APPEND _spice_manifest ",\n")
endif()
set(_spice_first FALSE)
FetchContent_GetProperties(hiredis)
if(EXISTS "${hiredis_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
  set(_spice_hiredis_inc "${hiredis_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
else()
  set(_spice_hiredis_inc "${hiredis_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()
set(_spice_hiredis_bld "${hiredis_BINARY_DIR}")
string(APPEND _spice_manifest
  "  \"hiredis\": {\n"
  "    \"resolved_via\": \"${_hiredis_resolved_via}\",\n"
)
string(APPEND _spice_manifest
  "    \"include_dirs\": [\"${_spice_hiredis_inc}\"],\n"
  "    \"link_dirs\":    [\"${_spice_hiredis_bld}\"],\n"
  "    \"link_libs\":    [\"hiredis\"]\n"
)
string(APPEND _spice_manifest "  }")

string(APPEND _spice_manifest "\n}\n")
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${_spice_manifest_path}" CONTENT "${_spice_manifest}")
message(STATUS "spice: will write cmake/spice-deps-manifest.json at generate time")
